content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen pushes the primary clinic photo almost completely below the fold, and the timetable bars later on lack the time-of-day axis labels present on desktop.","desktopNote":"The hero layout, custom timetable chart, and warm smile motif work together to create a reassuring, well-proportioned dental site, though the team section feels slightly sparse.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":5,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":5,"hierarchy":5,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":5,"distinctiveness":5},"fixes":["Slightly tighten the phone hero typography and vertical margins so the circular clinic photo is clearly visible above the fold.","Add subtle time labels (e.g., 7.00, 13.00, 19.00) to the phone's 'Ordinacijski čas' bars so the horizontal position of the shifts has clear context.","Pair the two photos in the 'Kdo vas sprejme' section more closely with the staff names, or use actual portraits, so the three-column desktop row feels unified rather than floating."]}
